title: Set both ends explicitly
summary: fromTo names both the starting and ending values.
introduction: fromTo names both the starting and ending values. Your task: Change the ending x to 160.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for set both ends explicitly

blocks.text: fromTo names both the starting and ending values. It helps when neither end should depend on the current style.
Use a browser project with GSAP 3 installed. Each example creates its own small box. Run one example at a time with a module build tool. GSAP is not loaded by this site's plain runner.
Read the code step by step

items: `textContent` reads or replaces plain text inside an element. It does not interpret the supplied words as HTML.
`createElement` makes a new element in memory. Append it to the document when you want it to appear.
`fromTo` supplies starting values and ending values explicitly. Timing belongs with the ending settings.

blocks.text: The box moves from x=0 to x=100 while becoming fully visible.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Put duration in the destination settings object. Do not hide essential content permanently if scripts fail.
